page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this server for compute-heavy workloads where processing power is prioritized over memory capacity.

Appropriate workloads for the ecs.c6t.8xlarge include high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive application servers. Its dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention.
